snippet.title: Jedidiah McCloud
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m Jedidiah.
I’ve been playing football for most of my life. At different points it’s been my dream, my career, my escape, and probably the closest thing I’ve found to therapy.
I’ve played professionally, spent years chasing the next level, and somewhere along the way started filming the process. What began as football videos slowly became something more personal, a way for me to document where I am, what I’m feeling, and the places this game takes me.
A lot of my life is still figuring things out. I’m still training, still creating, still chasing football, and still learning how to be okay with where I am while wanting more for myself.
This channel is the longer version of that story.
Training, traveling, creating, exploring new places, and whatever happens in between.
Football is the reason I started.
Somewhere along the way, it became my therapy.
I’m just documenting it.


contact@jedidiahsports.com
